formal_legal_status: independent professional actor performing verification under Annex V
institutionalization_basis: Article 15 and Annex V directly assign the verifier examination, access, analysis and reporting functions.
participation_basis: Member States shall ensure operator reports are verified; a non-satisfactory report prevents further allowance transfers.
separation_basis: Annex V requires the verifier to be independent of the operator.
independence_basis: Annex V(12) expressly requires independence from the operator and objective professional conduct.
capacity_brought_description: specialized professional examination of emissions reports, monitoring systems, data reliability and material misstatement
orientation_basis: The verifier's report and finding inform the competent authority and enter its compliance administration.
output_types: verification report; satisfactory or unsatisfactory finding
output_legal_effect_basis: An operator whose report is not found satisfactory cannot make further allowance transfers until a satisfactory finding exists.
accountable_to: Competent authorities through the required report
accountability_object: reliability, credibility and accuracy of the emissions report and professional conduct
accountability_procedure: application of Annex V criteria and preparation of a report stating whether the operator report is satisfactory
review_or_supervision: competent authority is informed; no separate review procedure is specified
notes: Intermediary status is frozen by REL-32003-006.

formal_legal_status: administrator designated under the linked EU ETS framework
institutionalization_basis: Articles 9 and 12 assign registry prohibitions, deductions and automated transaction checks to the Central Administrator.
participation_basis: The Central Administrator shall implement prohibitions, deduct allocations and conduct automated checks.
separation_basis: The Central Administrator is an EU-level registry body distinct from the Member States whose accounts and transactions are affected.
independence_basis: The Regulation assigns functions but states no independence requirement for this role.
capacity_brought_description: Union Registry administration, automated transaction processing and implementation of account-level compliance consequences
orientation_basis: The operative outputs block Member State transactions or alter Member State allocation positions in the Union Registry.
output_types: registry prohibition; allocation deduction; blocked transaction
output_legal_effect_basis: The registry action directly determines whether a transaction proceeds and changes the allocation recorded for a Member State.
accountability_object: registry execution under Commission accounting rules
review_or_supervision: Commission adopts the accounting rules applied in the registry; no accountability procedure for the Central Administrator is stated
meta_intermediation_note: The Commission establishes registry-accounting rules applied by the Central Administrator; any supervisory relation requires later adjudication.
notes: Intermediary status is frozen by REL-32018-005.

institutionalization_basis: Article 8(2) assigns the European Environment Agency a structured role assisting Commission assessment of corrective action plans.
participation_basis: The Agency shall assist when corrective action plans are assessed, in accordance with its annual work programme.
separation_basis: The EU agency is institutionally distinct from the Member State submitting the corrective action plan.
independence_basis: Article 8 assigns assistance but does not state an independence requirement.
capacity_brought_description: technical assessment capacity for examining corrective action plans and progress evidence
orientation_basis: The Agency's assistance is directed to the Commission's assessment and opinion process.
output_legal_effect_basis: The input supports the Commission assessment; the Commission retains authority to issue the opinion.
accountable_to: European Commission for the assigned assessment assistance
accountability_object: assistance in assessing corrective action plans
accountability_procedure: performance according to the Agency's annual work programme
review_or_supervision: annual work programme structures the assistance; no specific review or sanction is stated
notes: Intermediary status is frozen by REL-32018-007.

institutionalization_basis: Article 8(4) assigns the European Environment Agency a structured role assisting preparation of Commission assessments.
participation_basis: The Agency shall assist preparation of the Articles 6 and 7 assessments in accordance with its annual work programme.
separation_basis: The EU agency is institutionally distinct from the Member States whose measures are assessed.
independence_basis: The Regulation assigns assistance and recognizes EEA reports but states no independence requirement for this role.
capacity_brought_description: scientific and information-processing capacity for preparing assessments of national measures and collective climate progress
orientation_basis: EEA reports and assistance feed the Commission's assessment of Member State measures.
output_legal_effect_basis: The Commission bases assessments on EEA reports and receives EEA assistance while retaining recommendation authority.
accountable_to: European Commission for the assigned assessment assistance
accountability_object: preparation of assessments under Articles 6 and 7
accountability_procedure: performance according to the Agency's annual work programme
review_or_supervision: annual work programme structures assistance; no specific review or sanction is stated
notes: Intermediary status is frozen by REL-32021-010.

formal_legal_status: entities that may carry out measures ultimately benefiting defined vulnerable classes
institutionalization_basis: Article 9 permits support through public or private entities and legally structures their benefit-delivery role through safeguards.
participation_basis: Use of such entities is optional for Member States, but when used they must carry out measures ultimately benefiting the defined vulnerable classes and pass on the entire benefit.
separation_basis: Article 9 defines the entities as actors other than vulnerable households, vulnerable micro-enterprises and vulnerable transport users.
independence_basis: The Regulation requires safeguards for benefit pass-through but states no independence rule.
capacity_brought_description: implementation and delivery capacity for converting Plan measures and resources into services, investments or financial benefits for vulnerable groups
orientation_basis: The entities carry out measures and pass the entire benefit to three legally defined target classes.
output_types: implemented measure; service; financial benefit; mobility support
output_legal_effect_basis: The output constitutes legally safeguarded delivery of support rather than information, advice, evidence or a regulatory decision.
accountable_to: Member States through statutory or contractual safeguards
accountability_object: implementation of measures and passage of the entire benefit to eligible vulnerable groups
accountability_procedure: statutory or contractual safeguards required by Article 9(2)
review_or_supervision: Member States must structure safeguards; the specific supervision procedure is not stated
meta_intermediation_note: Member State statutory or contractual safeguards may structure oversight of implementing entities; any separate meta-level relation is deferred.
notes: The actor remains a legally open public/private class; specific organizational form, designation and accountability procedure vary or are not stated. Three supported relations are consolidated.

formal_legal_status: authorities responsible for management verifications and implementation
institutionalization_basis: Annex III requires designation of authorities entrusted with Plan implementation and assigns implementing authorities management-check functions.
participation_basis: Member States shall maintain an effective control system and implementing authorities will check milestones, targets and serious irregularities.
separation_basis: The implementing authorities form part of the Member State internal control and implementation system; the Member State is T in the supported relation.
independence_basis: The Annex separates managing and audit functions but does not require implementing authorities themselves to be independent.
capacity_brought_description: financial-management and internal-control capacity for checking milestones, targets, irregularities and double funding
orientation_basis: Check results support the management declaration and payment request assessed by the Commission.
output_legal_effect_basis: The results support the assurance accompanying a payment request and the Commission's assessment of satisfactory achievement and controls.
accountable_to: Member State internal control system and, through the payment request, the European Commission
accountability_object: achievement of milestones and targets and absence of serious irregularities
accountability_procedure: designated responsibilities, management checks, documented assurance and audit trail
review_or_supervision: independent system and operation audits are required under Annex III
meta_intermediation_note: Audit bodies conduct independent audits of systems and operations that may include implementing-authority performance; no meta-level relation is adjudicated.
notes: Intermediary status is frozen by REL-32023-013.

formal_legal_status: body designated to conduct independent audits
institutionalization_basis: Annex III requires designation of the body or bodies carrying out audits and requires adequate independent audits.
participation_basis: Member States shall conduct adequate and independent audits, and the payment request must include a summary of audits.
separation_basis: The audit body is designated within the Member State control architecture while remaining functionally independent from management functions.
independence_basis: Annex III expressly requires independent audits and documentation of the audit body's functional independence.
capacity_brought_description: specialized audit capacity for examining systems, operations, spending, fraud risks and control weaknesses
orientation_basis: The audit summary accompanies the Member State payment request and informs Commission payment and financial-protection decisions.
output_types: audit summary; identified weaknesses; corrective-action information
output_legal_effect_basis: The audit summary forms part of the evidence accompanying the payment request and relevant to Commission financial-control decisions.
accountable_to: Member States and the European Commission through the audit summary
accountability_object: independent audit of Fund systems and operations and identification of weaknesses
accountability_procedure: internationally accepted audit standards, functional independence, audit summary and retained audit trail
review_or_supervision: Commission reviews the audit information within payment and financial-protection processes
notes: Intermediary status is frozen by REL-32023-014.
